note: Imported in Overhaul slice 1 (data only). No game system reads this file yet.

entries.name: The Last-Second Survival
entries.scene: The hit lands and the screen holds its breath, then the Pokémon is still standing, trembling and furious.

entries.name: The Sweep From Nothing
entries.trigger: 3+ KOs in a row by one Pokémon after the rest fainted
entries.scene: One Pokémon walks out alone and the arena goes quiet. When it walks back, no one else has the heart to speak.

entries.name: Comeback Drums
entries.trigger: win while down to the last Pokémon vs. full team
entries.scene: The crowd noise fades into a steady drumbeat as the last Pokémon steps up. It does not look scared.

entries.name: No Wasted Turn
entries.trigger: win a battle with every turn dealing damage or boosting
entries.scene: Every move is purposeful. The opponent never had a moment to breathe.

entries.name: The Perfect Read
entries.scene: The trainer's eyes narrow. The Pokémon is already moving to meet the switch-in.

entries.name: The Bad-Matchup Hero
entries.trigger: KO a foe that resists all of its moves
entries.scene: It shouldn't work. It works.

entries.name: The Speed-Tie Win
entries.scene: Two Pokémon move at the same instant. The coin lands in your favor.

entries.name: The Critical in the Dark
entries.trigger: a crit ends a boss battle
entries.scene: The attack hits the exact spot that matters. Silence, then a roar.

entries.name: The Dodge Streak
entries.scene: The foe swings and swings but your Pokémon keeps just out of reach.

entries.name: The Weather Flip
entries.scene: Rain gives way to sun. The foe's plan drips away with it.

entries.name: The Status Stalemate
entries.trigger: win while both sides are statused
entries.scene: Both sides are hurting. One stays on its feet.

entries.name: The One-Hit Wonder
entries.trigger: KO a full-HP boss Pokémon in one turn
entries.scene: Not even the boss expected that. The arena goes silent.

entries.name: Tank It All
entries.trigger: survive 5 super-effective hits in one battle
entries.scene: The Pokémon braces after every blow. It does not fall.

entries.name: The Synchronized Strike
entries.trigger: two Pokémon KO the same foe in one turn
entries.scene: Two attacks hit at the same instant, and the foe drops without a sound.

entries.name: The Sacrifice Play
entries.trigger: a Pokémon faints to enable a teammate's win
entries.scene: It takes the hit so the next one can finish the job.

entries.name: The Revenge
entries.trigger: KO the foe that fainted a teammate on the next turn
entries.scene: The next Pokémon arrives with a cold look in its eyes.

entries.name: The Endurance Run
entries.scene: Both sides are exhausted. One is just a little less so.

entries.name: The Berry at the Brink
entries.trigger: a pinch berry activates in a boss fight
entries.scene: At the last breath, a berry restores a spark.

entries.name: The Priority Snipe
entries.trigger: a priority move finishes a faster foe
entries.scene: The faster foe never gets to move. It never expected that.

entries.name: The Rematch Redeemed
entries.trigger: win against an opponent that previously beat the team
entries.scene: The old defeat is a memory now. The trainer's hand relaxes on the ball.

entries.name: The First Victory
entries.scene: The first win, small as it is, makes the whole team stand a little taller.

entries.name: The Nickname
entries.scene: The name sticks immediately, as if it had always been there.

entries.name: The Shared Berry
entries.trigger: a berry is split between teammates
entries.scene: Two Pokémon share one small snack and a quiet understanding.

entries.name: The Nap Pile
entries.trigger: rest node with 3+ Pokémon that like naps
entries.scene: The team ends up in a single sleeping pile. No one is sure who started it.

entries.name: The Protective Stance
entries.trigger: a Pokémon takes a hit meant for a bonded teammate
entries.scene: It steps forward without being asked.

entries.name: The First Night Away
entries.trigger: a hatched or newly caught Pokémon's first rest node
entries.scene: It stays near the trainer all night, eyes open.

entries.name: The Heart-to-Heart
entries.scene: The Pokémon sits down next to you and stays there.

entries.name: The Reluctant Friend
entries.trigger: a Pokémon with an independent personality reaches bond 50
entries.scene: It still pretends not to care, but it walks closer to you than before.

entries.name: The Glimmer
entries.trigger: first battle after catching a shiny
entries.scene: The sun catches the Pokémon's coat in a way that no one forgets.

entries.name: The Surprise Party
entries.scene: The team gathers around, a bit awkward, a bit proud.

entries.name: The Lullaby
entries.trigger: rest node with a Pokémon that knows a sound move
entries.scene: A soft song drifts across the camp until everyone is asleep.

entries.name: The Storm Shelter
entries.scene: The team presses together under a rock overhang while the rain falls.

entries.name: Tough Love
entries.trigger: a trainer scolds a Pokémon after a mistake and it improves
entries.scene: The Pokémon takes the lesson to heart, then does it right.

entries.name: The Long Goodbye
entries.trigger: a Pokémon is released or traded after bond 70
entries.scene: It looks back until you cannot see it anymore.

entries.name: The Promise at Dawn
entries.trigger: a Pokémon at bond 100 at a rest node
entries.scene: A quiet exchange at dawn. No words needed.

entries.name: The Trust Fall
entries.trigger: a Pokémon succeeds at a risky move after a trainer's call
entries.scene: The Pokémon trusts the call completely.

entries.name: The Evolving Light
entries.scene: The light grows and the old shape fades. The new one steps forward as if it had always been there.

entries.name: The Interrupted Evolution
entries.scene: The light fades. The Pokémon blinks and looks relieved, or confused.

entries.name: The Trade Evolution
entries.scene: The exchange machine hums and glows, and something new emerges on the other side.

entries.name: The Stone's Light
entries.scene: The stone dissolves in light as the Pokémon lifts its head.

entries.name: Evolution at Dusk
entries.scene: The dusk deepens as the Pokémon changes, and the stars watch.

entries.name: The Mid-Battle Evolution
entries.trigger: evolved right after a battle ends
entries.scene: Battle's end brings the glow. The crowd falls silent.

entries.name: The Mega Surge
entries.scene: Energy rises through the Key Stone and the Pokémon's silhouette blazes.

entries.name: The Dynamax Tower
entries.scene: The Pokémon grows tall as a building and the weather rushes to catch up.

entries.name: The Tera Crown
entries.scene: A crystal crown shimmers into place over the Pokémon's head.

entries.name: The Z-Pose
entries.scene: The trainer and Pokémon strike a pose that crackles with power.

entries.name: The Hyper Surge
entries.scene: The trainer's pulse and the Pokémon's pulse sync for a heartbeat.

entries.name: The Overdrive Roar
entries.scene: The Pokémon roars and the air itself cracks.

entries.name: The Primal Return
entries.scene: The ancient form returns and the sky rearranges itself to fit it.

entries.name: The Form Change
entries.trigger: form change triggered by weather or time
entries.scene: A breeze passes and the Pokémon changes with it.

entries.name: The Mastery Flourish
entries.scene: The move gets a flourish that wasn't there before.

entries.name: The Path Chosen
entries.scene: The Pokémon seems to settle into a role it was meant for.

entries.name: The Thirty Mark
entries.scene: A small change in posture: it has stopped being a beginner.

entries.name: The Late Lesson
entries.trigger: a Pokémon learns a move 10+ levels later than usual
entries.scene: The move comes slowly, and so does the smile.

entries.name: The TM Surprise
entries.trigger: a TM teaches an unexpected move
entries.scene: The Pokémon blinks at the new move, then tries it with delight.

entries.name: The Training Montage
entries.scene: Cut to the Pokémon running laps while the music rises.

entries.name: The First Boss
entries.scene: The banner drops. The Pokémon steps up beside you.

entries.name: The Badge
entries.scene: The badge catches the light for a moment before it is pinned.

entries.name: The Elite Door
entries.scene: The doors close behind you. There's no turning back.

entries.name: The Champion's Throne
entries.scene: The arena lights rise, and the champion stands with their back to you.

entries.name: The Rival Meeting
entries.scene: The rival smiles. It isn't friendly.

entries.name: The Rival's Respect
entries.scene: They look at you for a long moment and nod.

entries.name: The Rival's Confession
entries.scene: The rival says what they never meant to say.

entries.name: The Team-Up
entries.trigger: a rival joins a double battle
entries.scene: For one battle, you fight side by side.

entries.name: The Calm Before
entries.trigger: a rematch against the rival after they won last time
entries.scene: Both of you wait. Neither wants to blink.

entries.name: The Rival's Gift
entries.scene: They hand it over without looking at you.

entries.name: The Bitter Defeat
entries.scene: They don't gloat. Somehow that's worse.

entries.name: The Final Sprint
entries.scene: The wind picks up and neither of you speaks.

entries.name: The Sighting
entries.scene: A shape passes over the horizon, and everyone looks up.

entries.name: The Awakening
entries.scene: The ground trembles once. Then again.

entries.name: The Hush
entries.scene: The arena falls silent as the ball closes. Then, a single click.

entries.name: The Empty Sky
entries.scene: The sky is empty where it was. Everyone feels it.

entries.name: The Hold
entries.scene: It watches you in a way that wants to speak.

entries.name: The Glimpse
entries.scene: It vanishes before you are sure it was there.

entries.name: The Offering
entries.trigger: an item is placed at a shrine
entries.scene: The shrine glows softly and a distant bell rings.

entries.name: The Arrival
entries.scene: The map unfolds and the new music begins.

entries.name: The First Snow
entries.trigger: snow node for the first time
entries.scene: A Pokémon catches a flake on its nose and freezes in awe.

entries.name: The Heat Haze
entries.scene: Even the shadows seem to wobble.

entries.name: The Cave Glow
entries.scene: The walls shimmer in colors no one expected.

entries.name: The Mountain Top
entries.scene: The whole region unrolls below.

entries.name: The Sea Breeze
entries.scene: Salt and sunlight. The team relaxes.

entries.name: The City Lights
entries.scene: The team stares at the lights like small stars.

entries.name: The Forest Hush
entries.scene: The birds stop. The wind stops. Something old is watching.

entries.name: The Ruin Echo
entries.scene: Each footstep returns half a second late.

entries.name: The Puddle Splash
entries.scene: One Pokémon splashes. Another follows. The trainer sighs.

entries.name: The Fireflies
entries.scene: Lights drift up from the reeds and the whole team goes quiet.

entries.name: The Shooting Star
entries.scene: A line of light crosses the sky. Everyone watches.

entries.name: The Old Road
entries.scene: A road older than any map continues beyond the trees.

entries.name: The Harbor Bells
entries.scene: Distant bells carry across the water and the team turns toward them.

entries.name: The Village Festival
entries.scene: The team is pulled into a dance that nobody planned.

entries.name: The Shop Window
entries.trigger: shop node with a rare item
entries.scene: A Pokémon presses its nose to the glass.

entries.name: The Night Shift
entries.scene: The nurse hums while the team sleeps.

entries.name: The Town Greeting
entries.scene: A familiar face waves and the team waves back.

entries.name: The Gym Lobby
entries.scene: The team stands still and listens to the echo of previous matches.

entries.name: The Team Photo
entries.scene: Everyone holds still for a moment. One Pokémon blinks at the wrong time.

entries.name: The Chemistry Click
entries.scene: A glance between two teammates that wasn't there yesterday.

entries.name: The Trio Pose
entries.scene: Three Pokémon fall into a pose they clearly rehearsed.

entries.name: The Friendly Spar
entries.trigger: two bonded teammates spar at rest
entries.scene: Dust, laughter, and a quiet score kept by both.

entries.name: The Welcome
entries.scene: Everyone makes a space. Someone slides over.

entries.name: The Veteran's Guidance
entries.trigger: an elder teaches a young Pokémon
entries.scene: The older one demonstrates once and walks away, trusting.

entries.name: The Sibling Spat
entries.trigger: two teammates of the same line disagree
entries.scene: A shout, a sulk, a reconciliation over a berry.

entries.name: The Huddle
entries.trigger: before a boss battle with high morale
entries.scene: The team gathers, shoulder to shoulder, for a breath.

entries.name: The Heavy Silence
entries.scene: Nobody speaks. A Pokémon quietly leans against the lead.

entries.name: The Morale Spike
entries.scene: The mood turns, like sunlight breaking through.

entries.name: The Captain
entries.scene: The others quietly look to it first.

entries.name: The Rookie Shines
entries.trigger: a lowest-level Pokémon lands a decisive KO
entries.scene: The team looks at the rookie with new respect.

entries.name: The Underdog
entries.scene: It was never the strongest, but it never gave up.

entries.name: The Oldest Friend
entries.trigger: the longest-serving Pokémon enters a boss battle
entries.scene: It has been here from the start, and it knows.

entries.name: The Hatch
entries.scene: The shell cracks, the room holds its breath, and a small voice says hello.

entries.name: The Egg's Warmth
entries.trigger: rest node with an egg in party
entries.scene: The trainer sits with the egg a little longer.

entries.name: The Rare Hatch
entries.scene: The shell glitters. Something unusual looks back.

entries.name: The First Steps
entries.trigger: a baby evolves for the first time
entries.scene: It wobbles, then walks with its head held high.

entries.name: The Trade
entries.scene: The machine hums. The Pokémon looks at its new home.

entries.name: The Return
entries.scene: The reunion is a quiet one.

entries.name: The Friend in Town
entries.scene: The NPC remembers your name.

entries.name: The Small Gift
entries.scene: They press it into your hand and look away.

entries.name: The Farewell
entries.scene: They wave until you are out of sight.

entries.name: The Rescue
entries.scene: You hear the cry before you see them.

entries.name: The Late Return
entries.scene: They look older, braver, or both.

entries.name: The Regret
entries.trigger: a choice leads to a bad outcome
entries.scene: The team says nothing, which is its own kind of comfort.

entries.name: The Right Call
entries.trigger: a choice leads to a good outcome
entries.scene: A quiet feeling that the road was right.

entries.name: The Gamble
entries.scene: The trainer breathes out slowly and says yes.

entries.name: The Refusal
entries.scene: The Pokémon looks up with new respect.

entries.name: The Chain Closes
entries.scene: The loose ends meet in one scene and the story settles.

entries.name: The Chain Lost
entries.scene: A flag remains of what could have been.

entries.name: The Campfire
entries.scene: Flames, quiet, and the day's story told by firelight.

entries.name: The Rainy Rest
entries.scene: The rain on the canopy is enough.

entries.name: The Snowy Rest
entries.scene: Shared warmth and snow falling softly on the tent.

entries.name: The Night Talk
entries.trigger: rest node after a boss battle
entries.scene: A quiet conversation under the stars.

entries.name: The Slow Morning
entries.scene: The sun rises and no one rushes.

entries.name: The Last Rest
entries.scene: The camp is quiet, almost reverent.

entries.name: The Berry Feast
entries.scene: Everyone eats until nobody can move.

entries.name: The Discovery
entries.scene: A glint in the grass. The team gathers to look.

entries.name: The Gift
entries.trigger: held item given to a bonded Pokémon
entries.scene: It holds the item as if it were precious.

entries.name: The Lost Item
entries.scene: The team spends a moment searching, then moves on.

entries.name: The Heirloom
entries.scene: It feels heavier than it is.

entries.name: The Bargain
entries.scene: The shopkeeper winks and the trainer pretends not to notice.

entries.name: The Starting Vow
entries.scene: The first step is always the quietest.

entries.name: The Midpoint
entries.scene: A look back at the road. The way ahead is long.

entries.name: The Last Stretch
entries.scene: The team can smell the end.

entries.name: The Victory
entries.scene: The arena empties. The team remains, breathing.

entries.name: The Quiet Defeat
entries.scene: The team does not look away from each other.

entries.name: The MVP Reveal
entries.scene: The story of the run is told through one Pokémon.

entries.name: The Epitaph
entries.scene: A line is written for the run.

entries.name: The Hall of Fame
entries.scene: Each Pokémon's name rises onto the wall.

entries.name: The Second Run
entries.trigger: new run after a completed run
entries.scene: The map is different. The trainer is not.

entries.name: The Guest Appearance
entries.trigger: a past run's Pokémon appears as an NPC echo
entries.scene: The Pokémon looks at you as if recognizing a friend.
entries.disabled: Cross-run memory is off (director decision C, 2026-11-06).

entries.name: The Mood Swing
entries.trigger: a Pokémon's mood flips after a win or loss
entries.scene: It laughs, then sulks, then laughs again.

entries.name: The Nervous Victory
entries.trigger: a nervous Pokémon wins a boss fight
entries.scene: It shakes and wins at the same time.

entries.name: The Brave Stand
entries.trigger: a brave Pokémon stands its ground against a legendary
entries.scene: It plants its feet.

entries.name: The Lazy Effort
entries.trigger: a lazy Pokémon makes an impressive play
entries.scene: It yawns, then does something amazing.

entries.name: The Curious Find
entries.trigger: a curious Pokémon finds an item
entries.scene: It runs back with the item, tail wagging.

entries.name: The Proud Refusal
entries.trigger: a proud Pokémon refuses an item
entries.scene: It would rather earn it.

entries.name: The Shy Step
entries.trigger: a shy Pokémon approaches an NPC
entries.scene: It takes one step and blushes.

entries.name: The Loyal Wait
entries.trigger: a loyal Pokémon waits at a gate
entries.scene: It stays exactly where it was told.

entries.name: The Mischief
entries.trigger: a mischievous Pokémon pranks a teammate
entries.scene: A feathered tail, a stolen berry, a smirk.

entries.name: The Stoic Smile
entries.trigger: a stoic Pokémon smiles for the first time
entries.scene: It happens so quickly nobody believes it.
